from server.pagination import paginate_query

class FakeQuery:
    def __init__(self, items):
        self._items = items
        self._offset = 0
        self._limit = None

    def count(self):
        return len(self._items)

    def offset(self, o):
        self._offset = o
        return self

    def limit(self, l):
        self._limit = l
        return self

    def all(self):
        start = self._offset
        end = None if self._limit is None else start + self._limit
        return self._items[start:end]

def test_paginate_query_overshoot_and_past_end():
    items = list(range(160))
    q = FakeQuery(items)

    # overshoot: offset + limit > total -> return remaining tail, no duplicates
    results, total = paginate_query(q, limit=50, offset=150)
